versions.changelog: Initial registry release: find duplicates by exact fingerprint, pHash distance, title, or remote ID; persist controls and result filters in shareable URLs; compare videos with authenticated, resilient FFmpeg playback; configure missing or conflicting metadata transfer; refresh Cove authentication in place during long jobs; process metadata copying and deletion independently per video; preserve unresolved videos; reconcile ambiguous deletion responses; and report exact progress and partial results.

name: Duplicate Manager
description: Advanced duplicate review, comparison, selection, and bulk deletion for Cove videos.
author: jiwenji
